name: CVS Pharmacy (retail)
why: Largest U.S. retail pharmacy chain (~21% Rx share, ~9,000 stores); CVS.com pharmacy account with Pay Ahead / ExtraCare.

name: Walgreens Pharmacy
why: #2 retail pharmacy (~8,000 stores); online Pharmacy Account Balance payment and ExpressPay stored card.

name: CVS Caremark
why: Largest PBM / mail-service pharmacy (~87M members); separate caremark.com billing site with order balances.

name: Express Scripts Pharmacy
why: Largest mail-order PBM pharmacy (~100M members); Autopay with maximum amount and Extended Payment Plan.

name: Walmart Pharmacy
why: ~4,600 pharmacies plus mail order; payment via the Walmart account.

name: Optum Rx / Optum Home Delivery
why: #3 PBM (~60M people); Optum Home Delivery balance payments and preferred payment method.

name: Kroger Pharmacy (and banners)
why: Largest grocery pharmacy chain (~2,200 pharmacies); My Prescriptions online payment.

name: Albertsons Companies pharmacies
why: ~1,700 pharmacies (Safeway, Vons, Jewel-Osco...); Rx Payment Manager.

name: Amazon Pharmacy (incl. PillPack, RxPass)
why: Largest online pharmacy; RxPass subscription billing and checkout charges.

name: Costco Pharmacy
why: ~600 warehouse pharmacies plus mail order; Pay Ahead and card-on-file billing.

name: Publix Pharmacy
why: ~1,300 Southeast pharmacies; rx.publix.com account to prepay ready refills (pickup, curbside, Instacart delivery) and print Medical Expense Summary statements.

name: Kaiser Permanente Pharmacy (incl. mail order)
why: Pharmacy of the largest integrated U.S. health plan (~12M members); orders and card checkout on kp.org/app with free mail delivery and auto refills.

name: CarelonRx
why: Elevance/Anthem PBM and home delivery pharmacy; member portal and app Make a payment (e-check or card) and claims history.

name: CVS Specialty
why: Largest specialty pharmacy; its own cvsspecialty.com Balance and Payments page with Automatic Payment (chosen day, set amount or balance up to a cap).

name: CenterWell Pharmacy
why: Humana's mail-order pharmacy (large Medicare population); Outstanding balance payments, Afterpay pay-in-4, mandatory 2-step login.

name: Accredo Specialty Pharmacy
why: Evernorth/Cigna specialty pharmacy with its own patient portal (accredo.evernorth.com, Make a Payment); card, checking or FSA.

name: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company
why: Best-known cash-price online pharmacy; email checkout, card-only, auto-refill charges the saved card, published shipping fees. (Roster duplicate -200211 skipped.)

name: Genoa Healthcare
why: ~750 behavioral-health pharmacies with monthly statements; E-Bill Express portal with Pay Now guest payment, recurring payments and paperless billing.

name: Capsule Pharmacy
why: App-based delivery pharmacy in major metros; texts to set up payment and schedule free delivery; receipts under Your Orders.

name: Blink Health
why: Large online discount pharmacy; pay-first purchases (credit/debit/FSA/HSA) for delivery or pickup, cancel/refund online.
